_source: Inbox (rules confirmed Oct 8, wordings Oct 9). At most 2 manager messages a week by priority; lower ones wait up to 2 weeks, then are dropped. The thresholds below are PROPOSALS for when each trigger fires.
_attendanceNote: Attendance for home league matches (PROPOSAL): the season fill rate (finance.json fillBase + fillMood) x a random 0.85-1.15, up to the Stadium's capacity. A full ground is a sell-out; under 60% is a low attendance.
_trainingNote: A player stalls after 12 training weeks without any attribute rising (players 29 or younger). 5 or more players improving in a week is a great week.
_storeNote: Big win: by 3+ goals. Bad run: 5 matches without a win. Star signing: a new arrival who goes straight into the squad's top 3 (shirts sold = reputation x 20-60). Monthly report every 4 weeks (store income for the month).
_youthNote: Youngsters are academy players 21 or younger. Ready for the first team: rated at least as high as the squad's 18th best player (once per player).
